title: Chunker — core/da_chunker.py + tests (GD-1 determinism, GD-2 lossless)
description: Implement magic-chunk segmentation per reports/da_blueprint/03_chunking.md: ~2K-token target (floor 256, ceiling 4096), boundary hierarchy paragraph>sentence>line>code-block>hard-cut with 64-token look-back + overshoot rule, deterministic ch_0001.. IDs with never-over-apply canonicalization, pluggable tokenizer (default deterministic whitespace heuristic like core/retrieval.py:_tokenize), token-aligned half-open ranges with merge-forward-on-mid-token, env knobs DA_CHUNK_TOKENS/DA_CHUNK_THRESHOLD_TOKENS/DA_MAX_CHUNKS, chunk index builder. Tests: GD-1 (100/100 same-ID), GD-2 (lossless reconstruction incl. whitespace runs, binary repr, overlong functions).

title: Parser — core/da_parser.py + tests (GD-4 engine arm)
description: Implement the incremental streaming tag scanner + FSM from reports/da_blueprint/05_engine_integration.md §1: resumable char-level scanner over decoded response text (handles tags spanning decode steps), states TEXT/TAG_OPEN/ATTR_KEY/ATTR_VAL/ATTR_END/CLOSING, emits OPEN_TAG(name, attrs)/CLOSE_TAG on the closing '>' of opening tags, mode machine GLOBAL/FOCUS/LOCAL (transition fires on closing '>'; <answer> is not a mode; revert to GLOBAL on matching close), EOF/partial-tag safety (sticky state), never-over-apply (malformed → no transition). Tests: partial tags across 'decode steps', malformed/garbage input, multi-chunk attr parsing, transitions; GD-4 engine arm = simulated model tag-stream corpus ≥95% yields parseable canonical valid-ID directives.

title: Mask builder — core/da_mask.py + tests (GD-3 fuzz safety)
description: DA mask/block-list builder: core/da_mask.py + tests/test_da_mask.py. GD-3 100/100 fuzz pass. 25 tests, ruff clean.

title: DA P1 — Synthetic LLM tasks (TC-2 + TC-4, 3-arm A/B, Path-b, tag adherence)
description: P1 per 06_validation.md §7: first LLM-involved phase on Ollama 27B (qwen3.8:27b-mlx), crafted short contexts (8–20K tok). TC-2 (RAG-QA negative control) + TC-4 (multi-hop tripwire) at n=20/arm; 3-arm A/B harness shake-out (A baseline / B tag-only no-op / C DA full; mask effect = C−B); Path-b client-side truncation harness (05 §3.2/§4) demonstrably re-sends only focused chunks + scaffold; tag-adherence floor measured. Exit gates: GE-1 attended-token reduction ≥15% (prefer ≥25%) AND no GQ-4 veto (TC-4 paired Δ ≤3pp pass, >5pp NO-GO) AND tag adherence ≥95%. Output Decision-gate-A card (GO/CONDITIONAL/NO-GO for Path-b) → reports/da_blueprint/07_p1_results.md.
